requirement: Skip setuptools additional-library installation for DSOs supplied as Nix-built CMake IMPORTED targets. Their source subdirectories were not configured by CMake and have no install build directory.

upstream_coverage.evidence: The selected upstream and final fork setup.py are identical. The additional_libraries loop unconditionally runs cmake --install with cwd=self.build_temp+file_path. It catches subprocess.CalledProcessError, but the missing cwd from imported targets raises FileNotFoundError before CMake can run. No per-library prebuilt-environment guard exists upstream.
upstream_coverage.non_equivalent_alternative: VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED uses a whole released wheel and skips building all extension modules. It does not preserve the Nix design of compiling glue against independently cached library derivations.

packaging_callers.evidence: Applies0001 before0004 and exports nonempty VLLM_XPU_PREBUILT_<NAME>_LIB paths conditionally for attention, GDN, MQA, MHC and grouped-GEMM split libraries.
Imported CMake targets replace add_subdirectory for each supplied library; setup.py forwards the same environment variables to CMake.
Composes native extension modules and verifies the FA2 DT_NEEDED/RPATH points to its selected split attention DSO; it does not require setuptools to reinstall those DSOs.

minimum_residual: Keep the six-line presence check unchanged. Packaging supplies nonempty store paths only for selected split libraries; absent variables preserve upstream installation for ordinary builds.

validation.check: git diff selected base..tip -- setup.py and blob comparison
Export exact fork setup.py and CMakeLists.txt to mktemp; apply0001 with patch --batch --fuzz=0; dry-run0004 with patch --dry-run --batch --fuzz=0 -p1
Apply0004 to temporary export and ast.parse patched setup.py with existing uv-created .venv/bin/python

limitations: No native build, wheel installation or GPU/runtime test performed by this audit. Parent candidate build remains authoritative. Source worktrees and host services were not modified.
newer_kernel_scope: v0.1.17 is not selected; broader compatibility review is in kernels-v017-compatibility.json. This verdict targets the frozen0.1.15.4 source pair.
